load_model_from_pretrained: load a pre-trained causal language model using AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained with dtype auto and trust_remote_code
load_tokenizer_from_pretrained: load a tokenizer for a model using AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained with trust_remote_code enabled
create_quantization_recipe: create a QuantizationModifier recipe targeting Linear layers with FP8_DYNAMIC scheme and ignoring lm_head and mlp gate layers
apply_oneshot_quantization: apply FP8 dynamic quantization to a model using oneshot with a QuantizationModifier recipe
save_quantized_model: save a quantized model and tokenizer to disk in compressed-tensors format using save_pretrained with save_compressed
